value.reason: Knowledge chunk directly answers the downgrade timing and feature retention question.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: Your downgrade will take effect at your next renewal date. Until then, you'll keep full access to your current plan's features. Before you confirm any downgrade, the confirmation screen will display the upcoming plan and its exact effective date, so you can verify the timing there.

citations.claim: A downgrade takes effect at the next renewal, current plan features remain available until then, and the confirmation screen shows the future plan and effective date.
